name: starlight-builder-lab
description: Build portable agent skills and packages with source-backed ecosystem research, worked examples and inspectable package checks.

interface.longDescription: Research agent ecosystems, define one useful workflow, generate a portable skills-only plugin and inspect its package. Includes worked examples and adverse cases. Requires host file tools to generate files and Python 3.10 or later to run checks. Structural checks do not prove workflow quality, host compatibility or directory approval. No billing, accounts, remote services or automatic publishing are included.
defaultPrompt: Help me build and test one portable agent workflow.
